dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: Ah! I—I'm busted, aren't I... Pl—Please don't tell anyone you saw me here.

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, I'm just staying here for the time being. My elder brother is a guard here — yes, he's the one guarding the cellar door.

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: I want to become a guard like him, but I'm not strong enough yet, so I'm learning in secret here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you have to hide in the cellar?

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: I'm not a Night Raven Guard, but I'm in the castle. If I were to be discovered by the other guards, my brother would be in for it...

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: Thank you! You are a kind soul indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Night Raven
dialogues.text: I will observe and learn as much as I can to become a Night Raven Guard worthy of the title!
